chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, from Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl, from Abu al-Hasan, from his father, from his grandfather (peace be upon them), who said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Adorn yourselves with rubies, for they remove poverty.'
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual benefit of wearing ruby rings according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In *Al-Kafi*, this hadith from the Ahl al-Bayt highlights the spiritual and material efficacy of wearing ruby rings, a practice rooted in Prophetic tradition. Scholars often interpret 'eliminating poverty' not merely as material wealth but as the removal of spiritual deprivation and the cultivation of contentment, reflecting the Shia emphasis on the interconnection between physical adornments and divine blessings.
